pages.text: $(italic)Sturdy, slow, and made for underground work. Dwarves excel at $(t1)Tier 1$()–$(t2)2$() play when mining and forging dominate.$()$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Mining Speed$() — +25% mining speed on stone and ore. Reduces to +15% in non-overworld dimensions.$(br2)$(bold)Fire Resistance$() — Permanent fire resistance IV. Lava does not burn you. Blazes deal 40% less damage.$(br2)$(bold)Sturdy$() — +8% armor effectiveness from heavy armor (iron, steel, diamond, netherite only).$(br2)$(bold)Slow$() — -10% movement speed permanently. The cost of being built like a boulder.
